notes: Known-answer prompts for general chat profiles. Every expected answer is a fact or a computation with exactly one correct value; the judge is deterministic (normalised substring / first-number / JSON-subset). max_tokens leaves room for reasoning-channel models, whose reasoning_content is never judged - only message.content.

cases.prompt: What is 17 + 25? Answer with only the number.
Which number is larger, 9 or 4? Answer with only the number.
What is the capital city of France? Answer with one word.
Repeat exactly this code and nothing else: ZX-4417
Return a JSON object with exactly one key "color" whose value is the string "blue". Output only the JSON.
